detail: Full summary: Records-tree git merges are conflict-free only for distinct new ULIDs — mutations rewrite the same file in place and removals unlink (src/storage/sync/record-export.ts:20-21), so two branches mutating the same record (e.g. both superseding one decision) can still conflict. The 'append-only immutable event records' framing is wrong.
